sections.installation:
1. Upload the wp-resume-builder folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin via the WordPress Plugin Repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. After activation, navigate to the ‘CV Builder’ settings page to configure options.
  4. Use the ‘CV Builder’ widget within the Elementor editor to start creating resumes.
sections.faq:
What is WP CV Builder SaaS, and how does it work?

WP CV Builder SaaS is a powerful WordPress plugin that allows you to create and manage your own CV creation platform. With this plugin, users can build professional CVs using 25+ ready-to-use templates, and download their resumes instantly. You can monetize your platform by offering free or paid CV creation services, integrated with PayPal for seamless transactions.

Do I need coding or design skills to use WP CV Builder SaaS?

Not at all! WP CV Builder SaaS is designed to be user-friendly and requires no coding or design skills. Simply install the plugin, choose your templates, and start offering CV creation services right away.

Can I use this plugin on multiple websites?

Yes, the plugin comes with unlimited site activation, allowing you to use it on as many websites as you like. Itâ€™s perfect for agencies, freelancers, or anyone looking to scale their SaaS business.

What payment options does the plugin support?

The plugin is integrated with PayPal API, enabling you to offer paid CV creation services. You can charge clients per CV or set up subscription plans, making it easy to monetize your platform.
